name: Mouse Tuner
author: MrChispa
description: Per-device mouse and trackball acceleration profile and sensitivity from the Omarchy bar, applied live and persisted across reboots.

barWidget.description: Set the acceleration profile and sensitivity of one pointing device without touching the others.

schema.label: Device name
schema.description: Hyprland device name to configure, for example logitech-usb-receiver-mouse. Leave empty to use the first mouse.

schema.label: Idioma / Language
schema.description: Panel language: EN (English) or ES (Español). It can also be switched from the EN·ES button in the panel header.
